searchText.title: Keyword
searchText.description: Job title words, e.g. data engineer, product designer, nurse. With no companies listed, the search runs across every company in the directories.

strictKeyword.title: Every keyword word must be in the title
strictKeyword.description: On: keep a job only when every word of the keyword starts a word in its title ("engineer" matches Engineering). Off: take each ATS's own matches, which are loose on Workday and SmartRecruiters.

matchDescription.title: Also match the keyword in the description
matchDescription.description: Keep a job whose description has every keyword word even when its title does not, e.g. a skill like Python or Kubernetes. Slower on Greenhouse, Workday, SmartRecruiters and Workable, which need one extra call per job.

postedWithinDays.title: Posted within (days)
postedWithinDays.description: Only jobs posted in the last N days. 0 for any age.

locations.title: Locations
locations.description: Keep jobs whose location contains one of these, e.g. New York, Germany, London, Remote.

platforms.title: Platforms
platforms.description: Limit to some of: workday, greenhouse, lever, ashby, smartrecruiters, workable, recruitee, personio. Empty for all eight.

companies.title: Companies (optional)
companies.description: Limit the search to these companies: names (stripe, nvidia), career-site URLs on any supported ATS, or tokens like greenhouse:stripe. Empty searches every company in the directories.

includeDescription.title: Full description
includeDescription.description: On: each job's full description, plus salary parsed from it where the ATS has no salary field. Off: no description, half the price.

onlyNew.title: Only jobs not returned before
onlyNew.description: On: each run returns only jobs earlier runs with the same search have not. For alerts on a schedule.

maxJobsPerCompany.title: Max jobs per company
maxJobsPerCompany.description: Newest first. Keeps one big employer from filling the run.

maxJobs.title: Max jobs in total
maxJobs.description: Stop the run after this many jobs.
